scripts.dev: concurrently -n maildev,backend,frontend -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev:maildev" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
